headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Neutral on Mid-America Apartment, Raises Price Target to $140
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Richard Anderson   maintains Mid-America Apartment (NYSE:MAA) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $132 to $140.
